execution_mode: Each unittest case executes in an isolated Python interpreter; executable evaluations use isolated fixture repositories and isolated HOME/CODEX_HOME directories.
limitations: The suite validates deterministic local behavior, synthetic hook payloads, migration safety, release gates, and executable offline evaluations.
Broader live Codex model coverage, WSL behavior, real worker ordering and cancellation delivery, cross-client reconnect, and an independent mega-audit still require RC evidence.
verification_note: The 116-case verified seed baseline is preserved. Product OS 4.1 adds five receipt v2 compatibility cases, seven rebuildable-registry and crash-safe lock cases, eleven read-only detection/dry-run planning cases, five external backup cases, twenty provider-neutral adoption transaction and migration-doctor cases, eight Local Git provider cases, sixteen bounded Codex selector adapter cases, six privacy-minimized lifecycle cases, four trusted CLI cases, and three fail-closed reviewed-release-evidence cases. Manager coverage includes end-to-end local-to-Git adoption, same-marketplace commit updates, receipt-bound predecessor derivation, canonical Git object-database provenance, Codex explicit-relative marketplace source compatibility, exact adapter binding and selector diffs, full plugin coverage, two-phase multi-plugin switching, journal integrity, ownership-envelope CAS, compensation, rollback, interrupted-retarget recovery and transaction discovery, read-only diagnosis without a surviving source repository, active-home refusal, lifecycle pending-to-PASS evidence with bounded retention, subprocess CLI fail-closed behavior, zero-write rejection, and preservation of unrelated selector and registry state.
